taskPacket.objective: An operator with one provider can opt in to same-provider review with a judge of equal or higher tier, marked in everything a human reads (R20).
instructions: Read R20 in the spec. Opt-in field `judgeIndependence: "same-vendor"` in the contract and in the machine config; without it, a node with no judge of another provider stays refused, as today.

Per-model tier in the harness catalogue (src/harnesses/catalogue.mjs DECLARED_MODEL_CATALOGUES/declaredModel): claude-sonnet-5 2, claude-opus-5 and claude-opus-5-5 3, claude-fable-5 and claude-fable-5-1 4 (declare the models the catalogue lacks). In the mode, the judge is another model whose tier is equal to or above the worker's; a lower tier is refused naming both tiers; a model with no declared tier cannot judge in the mode.

Mark every such node 'same-provider review': the Campaign Brief (src/campaign/campaign-brief.mjs is 772 lines: extract before adding; src/report/campaign-brief.mjs renders), the run report and status (src/report/render.mjs is 759 lines: extract before adding), and campaign metrics (src/campaign/metrics.mjs, src/report/metrics-report.mjs).

The canary reading of the scenario: node evals/judge-canary-matrix.mjs reports, per judge, its recall and false alarms on the cases written by its own family (byAuthorFamily already holds the counts), so a same-family judge is read apart. No provider is called.

taskPacket.objective: faberun plan takes its own ordered reviewer list, separate from the frozen contract's judge, and a plan reviewer never judges a worker's node (R19).
instructions: Read R19 in the spec. Today the review stage uses runtimeDefaults.judge (src/plan/template.mjs buildPlanningContract, KIND_ROLE maps review to judge) and the frozen contract's judge comes from the same default (src/plan/pipeline.mjs resolveRuntimes, src/plan/pipeline-shape.mjs toContractNode).

The review stage uses the first eligible reviewer (available, not refused); the frozen contract's judges come from the judge list of R18 (the contract or machine `judges`), never from the reviewer list. A reviewer of the planner's own provider no longer makes the frozen contract unroutable.
